name: [FREE]  Hotel Tycoon 2
desc:
🏨 Welcome to Hotel Tycoon 2!

[HOW TO PLAY]

🛎️ Serve your guests by clicking on them!
🛏️ Let guests sleep and enjoy hotel activities.
💰 Collect payments when they check out.
🏗️ Build, expand, and upgrade your hotel.


Please leave a Like👍 if you enjoy the game.

This game is currently in BETA, so please report any bugs you find. Thank you!
BETA players receive the exclusive in-game ALPHA Trophy+Badge!
